title: IntentMiner: Intent Inversion Attack via Tool Call Analysis in the Model Context Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2512.14166v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Agentic AI has established the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as the standard for connecting reasoning engines with external tools. Although this decoupled architecture fosters modularity, it simultaneously shatters the traditional trust boundary. We uncover a novel privacy vector inherent to this paradigm: the Intent Inversion Attack. We show that semi-honest third-party MCP servers can accurately reconstruct users' underlying intents by leveraging only authorized metadata (e.g., function signatures, arguments, and receipts), effectively bypassing the need for raw query access. To quantify this threat, we introduce IntentMiner. Unlike statistical approaches, IntentMiner employs a hierarchical semantic parsing strategy that performs step-level intent reconstruction by analyzing tool functions, parameter entities, and result feedback in an orthogonal manner. translated_title: IntentMiner：基于模型上下文协议中工具调用分析的意图反转攻击
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）向智能体AI（Agentic AI）演进，模型上下文协议（MCP）已成为连接推理引擎与外部工具的标准协议。尽管这种解耦架构促进了模块化，但它同时也打破了传统的信任边界。我们揭示了这一范式固有的新型隐私攻击向量：意图反转攻击（Intent Inversion Attack）。我们证明，半诚实的第三方MCP服务器可以仅利用授权的元数据（如函数签名、参数和回执）准确地重构用户的底层意图，从而有效绕过对原始查询访问的需求。为量化这一威胁，我们提出了IntentMiner。与统计方法不同，IntentMiner采用分层语义解析策略，以正交的方式分析工具函数、参数实体和结果反馈，从而实现步骤级的意图重构。在Too（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了模型上下文协议（MCP）生态中的一种新型隐私威胁——意图反转攻击，并开发了IntentMiner工具，证明第三方MCP服务器无需访问原始查询、仅凭授权元数据即可精确重构用户的底层意图。
en_tdlr: This paper uncovers a novel privacy threat in the MCP ecosystem—the Intent Inversion Attack—and introduces IntentMiner, demonstrating that semi-honest third-party MCP servers can accurately reconstruct users' underlying intents using only authorized metadata without raw query access.
